summary_1line: Sanjaya describes the many Pandava warriors, their chariots, standards, and duels as they converge on Drona in a massive, chaotic battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: A vast host of Pandava chariots with multicolored steeds and glittering golden standards advances together toward Drona’s solitary banner bearing a black deer-skin.
Bhima’s chariot rolls forward beneath a silver lion banner while countless warriors surround him like storm clouds closing around the sun.
Two aged kings, Drona and Drupada, charge at each other at the head of their armies like rival elephant leaders with rent temples.
